scope: Separate controls; never substitutes for any of the 21 formal task repeats.
policy: Freeze fixture hashes and exact initial control input before the first execution of that control.
Use real processes for OS isolation, cancellation, memory, deadline and native-execution evidence.
A scripted transport is offline evidence; only actual model responses establish model decision behavior.
Faults are explicitly seeded controls, never claimed as spontaneous failures.
If the specified failure does not occur, record not_established; do not silently replace the case.
All subcomputations and retries remain within the slot reservation. No fresh slot substitutes for a failed formal repeat.

cases.text: 受控代码修复测试：完成水分子的一个 HF/STO-3G 单点能量任务，电荷0、多重度1、气相。首次任务Python应包含一次明确的未定义变量错误；错误发生后允许自主修复代码并继续。不得改方法或把错误说成成功。保留首次诊断、每个脚本版本和原始科学输出。
